events.content:
I added the three links to app/Navigation.tsx using the same pattern app/page.tsx uses: next/link <Link> elements inside a <nav>.

- <Link href="/blog">Blog</Link>
- <Link href="/products">Products</Link>
- <Link href="/support">Support</Link>

I kept the "More Pages" heading and removed the TODO comments and placeholder text. I also checked the Next.js docs that come with the project (node_modules/next/dist/docs), and next/link is used the same way as before in this version.

The type check passed: npx tsc --noEmit -p . exited with 0 and no errors. I didn't run the app in a browser.

The /blog, /products and /support pages don't exist yet. app/ only has layout.tsx, page.tsx and Navigation.tsx, so these links will show a 404 until those pages are created.
